decisions.reason: The script-versus-storyboard angle precedence does not change the required bridge placement in the Q images.
The source addresses conflicting shot angles, not whether the separately confirmed and deferred opening aerial shot should be included.

Local context connects the discussion to CC1, but the source does not identify CC1_1 or establish whether the existing wide-to-close framing progression or unresolved distant-framing proposal conflicts with the script.
The precedence rule for shot angles does not alter the requirement to restore character shadows while preserving other image elements.
Selecting script-specified shot angles does not change the independent requirements for set-style alignment and shot-to-shot visual continuity.
The source changes shot-direction precedence but does not modify the project-wide artistic-style consistency rule.
